protocol.scope: stage7-8 final source; 450 sensors, 7 sinks, pilot-selected R=300m, E0=5J; benign ideal TX observer; finite 120.5s horizon; no real overhearing or full-lifetime FPR guarantee
protocol.grid_design: 8 declared structural settings, two tau candidates each; one-factor checks plus two joint settings, not exhaustive Cartesian search
protocol.fpr_definition: ever_suspected_by_horizon; all benign sensors and conditional on at least one valid cohort; window FPR reported separately
protocol.validation_policy: select using calibration_fit only; start benign_validation after selection is saved; reject freeze on validation failure; never reselect on validation
protocol.attack_validation_policy: reserved, not run or used for selection
protocol.evaluation_policy: 30 distinct seeds 51001..51030 reserved; zero evaluation before detector freeze; no reselection on evaluation
protocol.false_positive_reduction_policy: report not_demonstrated unless independent comparative evidence exists; adding K is not evidence

uncertainty: finite horizon and limited independent seeds; correlated node/window observations are not independent binomial trials; empirical FPR does not prove population FPR <=5%
observer_limitation: ideal TX observer; benign next-hop channel loss cannot by itself reduce relay forwarding ratio; no realistic overhearing/ACK loss calibration

freeze_verification.scope: stage7-8 final source; 450 sensors, 7 sinks, pilot-selected R=300m, E0=5J; benign ideal TX observer; finite 120.5s horizon; no real overhearing or full-lifetime FPR guarantee
